description.value: The Modern Pantry is a bakery, cafe, and retail shop in Ambleside, West Vancouver, known for seasonally inspired pastries, organic sourdough breads, and made-from-scratch soups and sandwiches. The space doubles as an event venue and stocks a freezer of freshly prepared take-home meals alongside artisan retail goods. Owner Kendall Parslow brings an international food background — including a Masters in Food Culture and time at Borough Market in London — to this locally beloved North Shore spot.

No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website.
